I had stuffed mushrooms in the oven, so while I was waiting on those, I read Tyler's post. Below is a summary.

The post can be divided into roughly three parts: 1. Shaky beginnings and the fight to keep the forum afloat, 2. Being hit by scandals that hurt the integrity of the forum and 3. A rather bland appeal for the community to return to sensibility and respect for one another.

In part one, Tyler speaks of days long past where he was just a kid on a forum. The internet was a wild west, and there was mutual understanding between posters that they wouldn't agree with each other on most things, but conversation was civil. Hosting forums sucks because it's expensive, and Tyler jumped from platform to platform, learning the ropes of hosting sites on the net, and becoming emotionally invested in what he thinks is a unique culture. He wants to see it thrive. Too many people use adblock.

Part Two begins. The passion for the GAF community is still there, but kid Tyler is now a man...child. He now has a retail job, on top of keeping the forum afloat. He goes out into the world, as all young adults do, to explore himself. Some unfortunate "#metoo" accusations happen. The actual "#metoo" stuff didn't happen though. Tyler is swift about making sure that he takes proper legal action in these cases. Everyone still calls him a rapist. Because he is principled he persists in keeping GAF alive. Discord rips through the forum as the trannies and blacks duke it out for the prize of winning the wig of social justice. The foot of the forum is run over by Trump train. The rage incites MOAR DISCORD!!!! Tyler is aware of this. It is an overwhelming time. His social circle changing. People on Twitter hate him because he is white and cis (totally not Jewish). Maybe its time to call it quits.

Part 3. Peak degeneracy is reached. The forum splits like an asscrack. GAF goes dark. But that same light in the hearth or dreams, that fire in the belly of kid Tyler ignites once, sweltering in the gasoline of passion. Grit. Hard work. Mistakes were made on other people's end. Tyler is just a guy with a hobby. Like you, or Zuckerberg. It's time to return to the "wild west", but a milder version. Gentlemen are gentlemen, but they are also Muslim and/or ladies. The call for action is to treat sitting around on a forum like sitting around in a bar. Disagreements exist, but no bar brawls, cuz you'll get banned. Let's make forums great again. Also, stop using adblock.

That was what I got out of that post. I enjoy amateur writing, so that's why I was masochistic enough to eyeball the whole post and mull it over.
